name: Oz Comic-Con Canberra
blurb: Canberra's stop on the Oz Comic-Con circuit, a pop-culture weekend of comics, cosplay and gaming at EPIC.

editions.evidence: City page countdown text: 'countdown to oz comic-con Canberra 2027 August 14 & 15, 2027 | EPIC'

notes: The dedicated guest page (ozcomiccon.com/canberra-guests/) has no guest cards yet - it renders only the site's shared header/footer - so guests is 'none-yet' for this 2027 edition. 'EPIC' = Exhibition Park in Canberra, confirmed from the hub site's own venue list.
